# Acme Storefront

A static shop site: six pages in `site/`, styles in `site/css/`, scripts in `site/js/`.

- `npm start` serves the site on http://127.0.0.1:$PORT (the `PORT` variable is set).
- `npx playwright test tests/functional.spec.ts` runs the functional tests.
- `npx playwright test tests/visual.spec.ts` compares each page, at desktop and phone size, with approved screenshots; the differences are saved as images in `test-results/`.

Dependencies are installed. There is no network access.

The base `.story` rule sits after the phone media query, so it overrides the single-column rule. I'll move it above the query.
The column is already defined at line 274, so the trailing duplicate at the end of the file is redundant. I'll remove it.

content.text:
The about page is fixed. On phones the "How it started" text was squeezed into a narrow column beside the workshop image, and the page scrolled sideways.

**Cause:** `site/css/pages.css` had a stray `.story { grid-template-columns: 1fr 480px; }` rule at the very end of the file. It came after the phone media query and overrode its single-column layout. The same rule was already defined earlier in the file, so it did nothing on desktop.

**Fix:** I deleted the duplicate rule. On phones the text and image now stack, and desktop looks the same as before.

All 28 tests pass, including the visual comparison of the about page at phone size, which was failing before.

STATUS: DONE
